recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Future hosted search service changes should be handled as site/tooling deployment work rather than a FHIR core source correction for this issue.
issue_request: FHIR-7255 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core-index issue asking that the standard be searchable, expanding search availability from the development version to ballot and published versions.
initial_application: No commit explicitly names FHIR-7255, but 2015 DSTU2 final build history added search.cfm/link generation for the homepage, and Jira comments later recorded that the request was already done.
additional_context: The current tracked homepage source links to search.cfm as "search this specification". Archived May 2015 ballot output includes a Search FHIR link, and the current published search form states that it searches all published FHIR versions and implementation guides. Local search*.html fragments are ignored generated/deployed site artifacts, not current tracked core source to edit.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the issue's requested search surface is already present in current source and published output.
